sloka: एवं बहुविधा वाचो ह्यन्तरिक्षगताः सुराः ।व्याजह्रुर्हृष्टमनसो दृष्ट्वा सीताप्रवेशनम् ।। ७.९७.२३ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ bahuvidhā vāco hyantarikṣagatāḥ surāḥ ।vyājahrurhṛṣṭamanaso dṛṣṭvā sītāpraveśanam ।। 7.97.23 ॥

translations.english: The celestial gods, with joyful minds, uttered various words upon witnessing Sita's entry into the earth.
